CustomField.description: The seller-decision commitment in hours: how long Sales has, from valid MQL entry, to accept or explicitly reject the handoff. A NORTHSTARIQ SYNTHETIC BUSINESS POLICY - not Salesforce behaviour and not a universal RevOps requirement. SEPARATE FROM Segment_Band__mdt.SLA_Response_Hours__c, which is the 4-hour first-touch response commitment measured from intake: different start, different stop, different accountable act. Held here rather than in the Flow so the business can change it without a deployment, and version-governed with the rest of the acceptance policy so a commitment stays interpretable after policy succession. TIME BASIS is the existing documented weekend-aware approximation - NOT Salesforce Business Hours and NOT holiday-aware. Blank means the policy issues no decision commitment, which is how every version before v1.2 behaves.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Hours allowed for the seller decision, from valid MQL entry.
CustomField.label: Acceptance Decision Hours
